profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Caterpillar Inc.
profile.summary:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer specializing in the automotive domain with deep expertise in C++, AUTOSAR, and safety-critical systems. 



With 8+ years of combined experience in development and testing, I deliver robust, production-grade embedded solutions compliant with industry standards like ISO 26262.  

► Core Competencies: Embedded C/C++, Python, RTOS, AUTOSAR, System Debugging, Test Automation 

► Tools & Technologies: Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer), Trace32, Google Test, Cantata, CMake, GitHub, Jenkins (CI/CD) 

► Protocols & Standards: CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, UDS (ISO 14229), ISO 26262  



Proven track record contributing to projects for leading automotive clients like BMW and Kawasaki, focusing on diagnostic stack integration and system compliance.  

I am actively seeking Senior Embedded Software Engineer or related C++/Automotive Software roles where I can leverage my skills to build next-generation vehicle systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Diagnostic & Failsafe Systems Development: Led diagnostic and failsafe subsystem development for BMW and Kawasaki premium motorcycle platforms, directly supporting critical safety features and diagnostic services. Owned end-to-end delivery of diagnostic services impacting production quality and customer safety. Architected software solutions in compliance with ISO 26262 functional safety standards, achieving ASIL-B certification for all safety-critical code modules. Implemented diagnostic service requirements in C++ following the Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) protocol. Designed and documented failsafe mechanisms ensuring graceful system degradation during critical failures. Collaborated with OEM teams to resolve technical requirements and validation scenarios, achieving a 100% pass rate on final customer acceptance testing with zero production defects. Debugging with TRACE 32 tool.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Firmware Testing & Automation Achievements: Designed and executed 150+ firmware test cases validating voice user interface features and audio signal processing across multiple hardware variants (Bluetooth, USB, Amazon Echo SDK). Developed Python-based Robot Framework automation, reducing manual testing effort by 40%, with 50+ reusable automation keywords for regression and CI. Implemented automated voice quality validation detecting algorithm degradation, and established nightly test execution pipelines ensuring code quality across development cycles. Created technical procedures for test environment setup, configuration, and hardware schematic analysis, plus troubleshooting guides that reduced field support requests by 18%. Validated noise suppression features with 80+ test cases covering audio quality metrics and real-world noise conditions, improving certification timelines by 20%. Engineered Bluetooth headset automation frameworks in Python, reducing test cycle time by 35%, covering connection, pairing, disconnection, and protocol compliance scenarios. Achieved a 98% pass rate on final firmware validation cycles, ensuring robust product release quality.

projects.title: Roll Autopilot Design using UDE(Uncertainty and Disturbance Estimation)approach.
projects.description:
•	The main objective of this project to provide Roll position stabilization to Roll Autopilots and Tactical missiles.      
•	Design of roll autopilot using uncertainty and disturbances estimation (UDE) approach. Design of roll auto pilot for tactical missiles or for aircrafts requires roll position stabilization. Control design based on the uncertainty and disturbance estimation approach.
•	 The effect of disturbances acting on the system will be estimating in real time and control efforts will generate to compensate for those effects using MATLAB/Simulink.
